Introduction: Strategy Choice and Rationale When the CHL-0200 Investment Challenge came along, Team 5 chose a mix of different equity strategy. The strategy initially was based on standard portfolio theory, implemented entirely through exchange-listed equities and ETFs. The original mandate was moderate-risk, fundamentals-first, benchmarked to SPY, with no single security intended to exceed roughly 9% of capital and no sector above about 25%, which is a sensible retail- policy adaptation of conventional portfolio construction constraints. Given the team’s size and range of viewpoints, the portfolio adopted a broad market perspective and expressed high-conviction views through technical timing, sector rotation, and macro-sensitive allocation decisions.
